items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ben Cole was leading it you say? ... [INTERVIEWEE] The lead of the range brass band, yeah.

ctx.x: Up there, up there in the French part of the country. Oh yeah. And he played up there. We talking about dude yesterday, me and Jim Robinson. He said, no I said...
Ben Cole was leading it you say?
